_meta.description: Per-location modality availability transcribed from official provider sites. Drives LocationServiceAvailability (offered/not_offered) and gates candidate->publishable price promotion so an organization-wide published price is applied ONLY at locations that actually offer the modality. Evidence-backed; never inferred from capability alone.
_meta.modality_of_slug: mri-* -> mri; ct-* -> ct; *ultrasound* -> ultrasound; *x-ray*/xray -> xray; mammogra* -> mammography; dexa/bone-densit* -> dexa

organizations.evidence_note: Per-location modalities from the official Derry Imaging site (locations/services). Derry is the flagship full-service center; Londonderry lacks CT; Windham offers ultrasound (+X-ray/mammography) only.
Dedicated single-service outpatient MRI facility (West Lebanon, NH). Offers MRI only; the flat $1,099 non-contrast self-pay price applies to all non-contrast MRI exams performed there.
